title: Simone Borselli
summary: Simone Borselli is the creative director and assistant director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. As the artistic director, he was responsible for many of the original designs for the series.
full_text: Simone Borselli is the creative director and assistant director of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. As the artistic director, he was responsible for many of the original designs for the series.
raw_wikitext:
'''Simone Borselli''' is the creative director and assistant director of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]''. As the artistic director, he was responsible for many of the original designs for the series.
